name: ghostcall
description: Trustless, untraceable 1:1 audio calls on Starknet. No TURN server. No trusted relay. No IP exposure.

scripts.bundle:electron: esbuild electron/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --outfile=dist/electron/main.js --external:electron --external:@starkware-libs/starknet-privacy-sdk --format=cjs && esbuild electron/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --outfile=dist/electron/preload.js --external:electron --format=cjs && cp node_modules/opusscript/build/opusscript_native_nasm.js node_modules/opusscript/build/opusscript_native_wasm.js node_modules/opusscript/build/opusscript_native_wasm.wasm dist/electron/
scripts.dev: concurrently "next dev renderer --port 3000" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && npm run bundle:electron && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron ."
scripts.build: next build renderer --experimental-app && npm run bundle:electron && electron-builder
scripts.build:mac: next build renderer && npm run bundle:electron && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:mac:arm64: next build renderer && npm run bundle:electron && electron-builder --mac --arm64

author: Philotheephilix
